notes: Latest FTB-published figures. FTB's own 2026 Form 540-ES instructions direct taxpayers to use the 2025 schedules, standard deduction and exemption credits for 2026 estimates; FTB publishes 2026 indexing in late 2026. Indexed amounts are inflated by the plan's inflation assumption after 2025 (FTB indexes by California CPI). Not modeled: exemption-credit phase-out at high AGI, CA non-conformity on HSAs (CA taxes HSA contributions and earnings), renter's credit, itemized deductions.
